anfield.name: Anfield

pitch.source: published figure is 101 x 68 (from memory); the Liverpool-Brighton broadcast clip fits a 105 x 68 marking model better than 103 or 101 (see docs/NEXT10.md, whole-match calibration), so 105 is used until the markings are surveyed

notes: fitted on the Liverpool-Brighton broadcast clip (sdr.mov, 10561 main frames, round 2 of solve_match, 105 x 68 markings model); camera = gantry about 36 m behind the near touchline at 16.4 m; k1 is weakly identified (0.14 to 0.46 across pitch-length hypotheses)
centre_sigma is inflated from the formal 0.005/0.03/0.009 m to the spread of C across 101/103/105 m pitch-length hypotheses (the formal value assumes the markings model is exact)
